purpose: Define a deterministic, lightweight asset-integrity manifest that can feed the future release/rollback manifest without authorizing production or publication.

manifest_rules.manifest_fingerprint: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON entries sorted by path with separators comma/colon and ensure_ascii=false

guardrails: Manifest integrity proves byte identity and declared provenance category only; it does not prove visual quality, licensing, gameplay quality, or human acceptance.
Do not include generated caches, temporary renders, recordings, build artifacts, secrets, personal data, or duplicate backups.
A changed locked asset must fail closed until the canonical authority is deliberately updated with appropriate review evidence.
